title: MOLE (Argo Astronautics, Star Citizen)

sources.title: Star Citizen game files: defaultProfile.xml and layout_t16000m_dual.xml (Data.p4k, build 4.8)

intro: The MOLE is a medium mining ship from Argo Astronautics in Star Citizen. The pilot flies while three operators in mining turrets work the rocks; 24 ore pods line the hull. In a mining turret the mining controls work as in mining mode.

panels.name: MOLE: weapons and modules
panels.text: This lists the MOLE's own weapons and special equipment, as the MFD weapons page and the ship data show them.
panels.context: Everything else in this cockpit works as in every Star Citizen ship: the same visor HUD, screens, seat actions and two-stick layout.

controls.name: Pilot guns (two)
controls.text: The MOLE has two guns for the pilot. The pilot aims them by pointing the ship's nose.
controls.context: The pilot fires them with the right stick's trigger in guns mode; the MFD weapons page shows their groups and how they aim.

controls.name: Ore pods (32 SCU)
controls.text: Ore pods along the hull hold 32 SCU of mined rock.
controls.context: When they are full the crew flies the ore to a station or refinery.

areas.name: Crew stations
areas.text: The other seats and stations of the ship besides the pilot's.

panels.name: MOLE: crew stations
panels.text: These are the seats and stations of the MOLE besides the pilot's seat.
panels.context: Each crew member sits at a station of their own; the pilot flies while the others work turrets or other equipment.

controls.name: Mining turrets (three)
controls.text: Three manned mining turrets. In them the trigger fires the laser, the thumb button changes the type and the base slider sets the power, as in mining mode.
controls.context: The pilot holds the ship near the rock while the operators break it apart.
